raw_segments.text: Hell opened to Christians they were having.
Jimmy Henry said pettishly about their damned Irish language.
Where was the marshal he wanted to know to keep order in the council chamber?
And old Barlow the mace-bearer laid up with asthma, no mace on the table,
nothing in order, no quorum even, and Hutchinson, the Lord Mayor,
in Landudno and little Lorcan Sherlock doing locum tenants for him.
Damned Irish language, language of our forefathers.
